title: Unit 42 Threat Intelligence Highlights - Nov. 2, 2026
description: Unit 42's November 2, 2026 threat intelligence highlights recent cyberespionage, financial extortion, and the growing use of AI in offensive cyber operations. The report details adversaries leveraging living-off-the-land tools, zero-day exploits, and spear phishing for espionage, as well as multi-extortion ransomware and business email compromise for financial gain. A notable trend is the integration of generative AI and large language models to enhance social engineering, scripting, and reconnaissance activities.
